cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I handed in our quiz sheet when that team did. Let's review our preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They'd finished. We'd only answered two questions. We came last.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, an early submission. We should concentrate on the hand-in procedure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Here's a blank practice sheet. I'll say when it's finished; you hand it in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Give me a confident nod when it's ready. That's the signal I'll be watching.

reason: Replace the unsupported confidence overlay with a concrete misunderstood copied action that directs the same-holder Drive pursuit, with a responsive partner and an ending using B4.
